## Astraeus 2.9.0: The Games Update

Hey everyone!

This one's big. Astraeus now knows when you're playing, keeps your best moments, and gives you a whole studio to turn them into something worth sharing. It all starts on the brand new **Games** page, and recording is off until you turn it on, so nothing changes for you unless you want it to. Have fun, and tell us what you make!

### New Content

**Games**
- Added the **Games** page. It finds the games on your PC from Steam, Epic, GOG, Ubisoft, Riot and the Microsoft Store, and shows how long you've played today and this week.
- Added game covers, which come in on their own. Rename a game and its cover follows.
- Added sorting by **A–Z**, **Last played** or **Most played**.
- Added a right-click menu on games: their recordings, a fresh cover, rename, don't record, or not a game at all.
- Added game sounds: a short sound when a game starts or closes, so you know Astraeus noticed even when a fullscreen game hides the pill.

**Clips**
- Added **Record games**. Astraeus quietly keeps the last moments of your game. Press **Alt+F9** (or a key of your own) and they're saved.
- Only the game's own window and sound are recorded, encoded by your graphics card.
- Added choices for how much is kept, quality, frame rate, size, a few extra seconds after the key, a longer-clip key, a pause key, and your microphone on its own track.
- Clips are kept per game in **Videos\Astraeus**.
- Added a **Recording** widget for the long pill. Click it to save a clip.

**The Clip Studio**
- Added a full-screen studio for your clips: trim, split into parts, and leave parts out.
- Added speed for any part, from 0.25× slow motion to 4×. The sound keeps its pitch.
- Added **9:16** for Shorts, Reels and TikTok, and **1:1**. Fill the frame and drag it to the action, let it glide between spots as the clip plays, or fit the whole picture in with black bars.
- Added background noise reduction, even loudness at the level YouTube and TikTok play, and **Cut silent parts**, each with a strength slider.
- Added voiceovers: talk over the clip as it plays.
- Added music: lay a song under your clip and snap your cuts to its beat.
- Added **Save**, **Save as a copy** (you carry on editing the copy) and **Copy for Discord**, which makes a copy under 10 MB ready to paste.

### Quality of Life
- Astraeus now starts faster. It shows itself the moment it opens, runs at full speed for its first few seconds, and its sign-in task no longer starts it below normal priority.
- The System page's gauges and bars now move smoothly at your screen's rate.
- The long pill now gives its memory back to Windows once it's been resting a few seconds.
- With two games open, Astraeus now follows the one you're actually playing.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
